loading_tips: Gulls steal fries. Guard your snack like it's the loot.
Tap twice to dodge. Tap three times to look nervous.
Rooftops are shortcuts. Railings are not trampolines.
Boss health bars flash red before a big swing.
Coins in puddles still count. Wet money spends fine.
Pier lamps mark save spots. Look for the blue glow.
Tugboats honk before they turn. Listen up.
The harbor fog hides enemies and also you.
Spin attack clears a crowd but makes you dizzy.
Stack combo hits to fill the hype meter faster.
Bike jumps score more if you land them clean.
Rain makes the docks slippery. Brake early.
Feed a stray cat and it might follow you a while.
Breakable crates hide snacks. Snacks heal.
Night shift guards yawn. Sneak past on the yawn.
Pigeons scatter when danger's near. Watch the sky.
Tow trucks never sleep. Park your bike off-street.
Grab the rooftop flag to unlock a new fast-travel.
Each district has a hidden mural. Find them all.
Lost? Follow the seagull trail back to the pier.
Hold block right before a hit for a perfect parry.
Ferry rides skip a district but cost five coins.
Shop prices drop on rainy days. Nobody's buying.
A full hype meter makes your next taunt deal damage.
Restarting a course keeps the coins you grabbed.
gang_barks: Dock Hounds don't share the pier!
